unsupported.twitch.post.text: Twitch has no general social-feed text-post endpoint.
unsupported.twitch.stream.start: Starting an encoder is separate from Helix stream schedules.
unsupported.twitch.video.upload: No general Helix VOD upload endpoint is documented.
unsupported.twitch.video.download: No general Helix full-VOD download endpoint is documented; authorized clip downloads are supported.
unsupported.twitch.analytics.dashboard: Creator Dashboard revenue, retention, watch time and unique viewers are not exposed by the documented general Helix API.
unsupported.twitch.channel_points.grant: No arbitrary Channel Points balance or point-grant endpoint is documented.
unsupported.twitch.subscription.purchase: Subscriptions are read/notification capabilities; this adapter does not purchase subscriptions.
unsupported.twitch.chat.history: Live chat is received through EventSub; Helix does not provide an arbitrary historical-chat archive.
